0022600099.text: The Chicago Bulls have not played a game this season yet, while the Milwaukee Bucks are 0-1 after their only game so far, sitting fifth in the Central and 15th in the East. Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins, who are both out with illness, and Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury. The teams have not met in the 2026-27 season, and the Bulls lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, though Chicago won their most recent meeting 120-97 in Chicago on March 1.
